name: remind bot
description: Takes screenshots, pasted chat threads or typed notes and turns the times and places buried in them into reminders — the errand-and-admin kind that never justify a calendar entry. Suits people whose commitments arrive as messages rather than invitations; it is a nudge system, not a shared diary.

official.title: Remind Bot by Damon
official.description: A catch-all for errands, school stuff, and personal reminders that do not belong on a calendar. Drop a screenshot with a time and place, paste a chat...
